_meta.purpose: Machine-readable hardware manifest for the research-pipeline quality gate: before proposing a tool/framework/model, the research trigger checks it against this fleet and silently drops anything that does not support our specific hardware (see fleet_constraints).
_meta.update_policy: lumen_state.py is the source of truth for live nodes; regenerate this file when a node is added/retired or re-provisioned. Fields not recorded anywhere are null, never guessed.

schema.nodes: SSH-reachable (or planned) fleet compute/service boxes, keyed by hostname
schema.device_classes: bench/RE devices and appliances that are not general-purpose fleet nodes

fleet_constraints.comment: The filter rules. A research-pipeline tool suggestion must clear every applicable row or be dropped.
fleet_constraints.nvidia_note: ZERO NVIDIA silicon anywhere in the fleet. Any tool that requires CUDA, cuDNN, TensorRT, nvidia-smi, or 'a recent NVIDIA GPU' is unusable — drop it.
fleet_constraints.rocm_note: No ROCm targets. FirePro D300 (Curacao/GCN1) and D500 (Tahiti/GCN1) are unsupported by ROCm; BC-250 gfx1013 is NOT a ROCm target either (bc250.training_and_autoevolve_assessment: HSA_OVERRIDE/hipBLAS path assessed REJECTED/non-functional). Drop ROCm/HIP-only tools.
fleet_constraints.apple_silicon_note: The Mac Pro 6,1 trashcans run Linux on Intel Xeon; no M-series, no Metal, no MLX. Drop MLX/CoreML/Metal-only tools.
fleet_constraints.gpu_compute: Vulkan/RADV only, and only on: nephthys (2x FirePro D500, llama.cpp Vulkan measured pp512 321-343 t/s wq#2501) and the BC-250 blades once up (gfx1013 via llama-server Vulkan, per ops/wq3651-bc250-bios-flash-governor/RUNBOOK-ADDENDUM.md). Everything else is CPU-only inference.
fleet_constraints.avx512_note: Newest Xeon is Broadwell (E5-2699 v4) and newest cores are Alder/Raptor Lake client SKUs — none expose AVX-512. AVX2 is the x86 baseline (Mac Pool Ivy Bridge E5-2697 v2 is AVX1-only). Drop AVX-512-required builds; prefer AVX2-or-lower or aarch64-NEON builds.
fleet_constraints.no_windows_host: Mirror (the only Windows box) was decommissioned 2026-08-28 (aten.role). Windows-only tools are unusable until Frank designates a new host.
fleet_constraints.network_note: Fleet spans a router-to-router wifi bridge (research/FLEET_MAP.md): tools that assume fast node-to-node transfer of tens-of-GB artifacts need bridge-side awareness; agent-driven ollama/podman/git-lfs pulls are policy-blocked (wq#1297).
